title: Pete and These Hens
lines: Pete hunts for Eve at the lake.
Eve is not in the tall grass.
Steve the cat naps on a stone.
Steve gets up and Eve hops off.
Pete grins. That hen is brave.

questions.ask: Which hen does Pete hunt for?
questions.listenFor: Eve. If they can not recall the name, have them find the capital E on the page.
On Steve the cat's back. Listen for them putting the cat and the hen together, not just "by the lake."

questions.ask: Do you think Steve likes having a hen on him? Tell me why.
questions.listenFor: Either answer is fine. Look for a reason from the story, such as "no, because he got up."
